title: Outbox Pattern
description: Implement the outbox pattern for reliable event publishing.

data.text: The outbox pattern ensures events are published reliably. Events are stored in the database as part of the transaction, then relayed to a message broker.

terms.definition: Storing events in the database for reliable publishing.
A table that stores events to be published.
A process that reads the outbox and publishes to the broker.
Writing events and business data in the same transaction.

data.text: Publishing an event and updating the database are two operations. If one fails, data and events become inconsistent. The outbox pattern solves this.

items: Atomic write of data and event

data.text: The outbox pattern provides at-least-once delivery. Consumers must be idempotent to handle duplicates.

data.caption: Outbox Pattern
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    Svc[Service] -->|1. Write data + event| DB[(Database)]
    DB -->|Outbox Table| Relay[Relay Process]
    Relay -->|2. Publish| Broker[(Message Broker)]
    Broker -->|3. Deliver| Consumer[Consumer]

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Outbox ensures atomic data and event writes
data.takeaway: The outbox pattern provides reliable event publishing.
